description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the statistics of reasoning-type distribution for Self-reflection SFT data. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variables representing different reasoning types, with the text labels slanted diagonally. The vertical axis represents the "Number of Samples" and employs a logarithmic scale (base 10), with a displayed range from 10² to 10⁴ and major tick marks at 10², 10³, and 10⁴. Faint dashed horizontal gridlines extend from the vertical axis across the plot area. The chart features six solid light blue bars sorted in descending order of their height. Each bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation placed directly above it. The tallest bar corresponds to "Mathematical Reasoning" with a value of 7025. Moving left to right, the subsequent bars represent "General Reasoning" (1709), "Natural Scene Reasoning" (413), "Physical Reasoning" (232), and "Logical Puzzle Reasoning" (91). The shortest bar on the far right represents "Chemical Reasoning" with a value of 49.
